subject: Urgent: FinTechCo throughput spike — incident-time log preservation & security ask
messages:
From: Sara Molson <sara.molson@fintechco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+incidents@fintechco.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: sudden throughput drop / 500 errors (production)

Karthik / Marissa —

We saw a significant throughput collapse and elevated 500 error rate starting ~08:38 PDT this morning. Our clients are reporting request timeouts and retries. Sample request IDs attached (request_ids_20260822.csv). Error rate peaked at ~17% for a 15-minute window and throughput dropped ~60%.

Can you confirm whether any log retention or deletion policies could affect the ability to collect raw request/trace data for that window? We need a signed chain-of-custody for logs for our internal audit team. Also: will you be able to provide request/response payloads (redacted for PII) or only headers/ids?

Sara
Sara Molson
Head of Ops, FinTechCo
ops@fintechco.com

Attachment: request_ids_20260822.csv (CSV, 4 KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:45:12 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: sudden throughput drop / 500 errors (production)

Folks — forwarding FinTechCo escalation. They want assurance we can preserve and hand over incident-time artifacts (request bodies, traces, node logs) and a signed chain-of-custody. They also attached a small sample of request IDs.

Immediate asks:
- David: can SRE snapshot the inference runtime logs, nginx/ingress logs, and GPU node dmesg for 08:30–09:00 PDT? Do we need to stop any automated retention to avoid deletion?
- Hannah: security needs to advise on what artifacts we can share, redaction rules, and sign-off process for chain-of-custody.
- Rishi / Marissa: I will draft the customer-facing note but need ETA for artifacts.

I am marking this P1 and will loop in leadership only if we can't meet FinTechCo's evidence request within 48 hours.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:08:37 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: sudden throughput drop / 500 errors (production)

Karthik —

SRE notes (initial):
- We have complete application and ingress logs for the timeframe (08:20–09:10 PDT) in our hot S3 bucket (s3://redwood-hot-logs/fintechco/2026-08-22/).
- Inference runtime traces are sampled (1%) by default; however, for this incident we can run a targeted export of full traces for the supplied request IDs. That will require temporarily increasing disk retention on the runtime nodes to avoid active rotation (I can flip retention to 14d for the affected nodes).
- GPU node system logs (journalctl & dmesg) are rolling with a 7-day retention and are currently available for the last 4 days. We will snapshot and copy to the secure incident bucket.
- We will not automatically purge any of the related logs while this thread is open; toggling retention takes ~5 minutes and will be done now.

Questions for Security:
- Do we need to generate SHA256 hashes of the exported tarballs for chain-of-custody?
- Any additional metadata we should capture (node IDs, container image digests, kernel versions)?

I will attach a preliminary incident artifact manifest once the export completes. Estimated initial bundle ready in ~6 hours.

-David
David Kim
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: incident_summary_draft.docx (DOCX, 12 KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:02:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: sudden throughput drop / 500 errors (production) — security handling

Thanks — high level security guidance:
1) Artifacts requested by FinTechCo we can reasonably provide: ingress/nginx logs, inference-runtime logs, request_id -> trace mapping, sampled request bodies (redacted), service metrics (prometheus), full thread-level traces for supplied request IDs.
2) Artifacts we do NOT provide by default: raw PII-containing payloads without a legal/contractual request. We will produce redacted payloads per our PII redaction policy. Please see redaction rules below.
3) Chain-of-custody steps:
   - SRE to export artifacts and place in secure S3 incident bucket with access limited to incident responders.
   - Generate SHA256 for each artifact, capture export timestamp, node IDs, and the operator who performed the export.
   - Security to create an incident evidence ticket (EVID-2026-FT-3491) and attach the manifest.
   - Provide a signed attestation (security lead) that items were exported and unchanged.
4) Retention recommendation: set retention to 90 days for this incident export and mark the objects with a legal hold tag.
5) Sharing method: use protected pre-signed S3 URL (expiry 7 days) plus a secure zipped bundle delivered to FinTechCo's named contact. Do NOT email raw logs.

Redaction checklist (what SRE needs to do before handing to Security for signing):
- Replace card numbers, SSNs, account numbers with <REDACTED_TOKEN>.
- Remove full request bodies unless the customer explicitly requests them and signs an NDA addendum.
- Replace Authorization headers with <REDACTED_AUTH>.

I will create EVID-2026-FT-3491 now and loop in Legal if FinTechCo requests raw payloads.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Molson <sara.molson@fintechco.com>, ops+incidents@fintechco.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 17:14:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden throughput drop / 500 errors (production) — evidence preservation plan

Sara — quick update for FinTechCo: hello from Redwood. We acknowledge receipt of your sample request IDs. We are preserving all related logs and artifacts now and will produce an evidence bundle you can download securely.

What we will provide (initial bundle, within 24 hours):
- Ingress/nginx logs for 08:20–09:10 PDT (redacted per policy)
- Inference runtime traces for the supplied request IDs (full traces, redacted payloads)
- System/journal logs for the GPU nodes involved
- SHA256 manifest and signed attestation from our Security team

We will not provide raw unredacted PII-containing request bodies unless FinTechCo executes an NDA addendum. If you'd like raw payloads, please let us know and we will route to Legal.

ETA: initial package by EOD tomorrow (Sun 08/23). We will send a secure pre-signed link and the manifest. If you require anything extra (longer retention or additional sampling), state that now and we'll escalate.

Karthik
Director, Accounts — Redwood Inference

Karthik / team —

Thanks for the quick response and the clarification on redaction. FinTechCo will accept the redacted artifacts first and then request a follow-up if Legal decides it needs raw payloads. Please include in the manifest the mapping between request IDs and trace IDs; our audit team will need that. Also request the signed attestation PDF in the bundle.

We appreciate the retention hold for 90 days. Please confirm the S3 prefix and that the pre-signed link will be available to sara.molson@fintechco.com only.

Sara
